proposal.title: Investigation into Solar Energy Optimization: An Agentic AI Framework for High-Assurance Decision Systems
proposal.executive_summary: This research proposal presents a novel agentic methodology to address fundamental challenges in Solar Energy Optimization. Operating out of vvv, the project unites automated multi-agent coordination with verifiable domain guardrails, achieving measurable improvements over current industry benchmarks. The initiative directly targets core objectives in Civil,Ai by deploying verifiable experimental pipelines.
proposal.methodology: The experimental methodology establishes a closed-loop renewable energy optimization architecture: (1) High-frequency telemetry acquisition from solar PV inverters and wind turbine controllers; (2) Multi-horizon irradiance and wind speed predictive modeling; (3) Multi-agent decentralized consensus dispatch algorithm; and (4) Experimental power hardware-in-the-loop validation under simulated grid disturbance scenarios.
